slides.title: Research as a connected process
slides.caption: Tools do bounded work; the campaign graph determines how they fit together.

slides.title: AI decisions remain inspectable
slides.caption: This recorded model abstained. Its context and decision remain available for inspection.

slides.title: Evidence behind a claim
slides.caption: Knowledge links retain their source and applicability. A relationship is not automatically a proven fact.

slides.title: Choose what to learn next
slides.caption: A local human focus draft preserves the research point and intended learning. It has not been submitted or executed.

slides.title: Build on previous work
slides.caption: The subsequent campaign retains an explicit connection to its predecessor and carried result.

slides.title: Keep corrections visible
slides.caption: New information changes the later interpretation while preserving the original history. Scientific applicability remains unresolved.
